          "rationale": "The artifacts protect focused controls only in part. For form fields and contenteditable elements, the viewer ignores every key.           "rationale": "Before creating a presentation, the artifacts commit to detecting the infrastructure, choosing where it goes and scaffolding what is missing.           "id": "INV-055",
